_note: Scaled reproduction: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (paper: base Mistral-7B), 200 generated tokens, C4 realnewslike prompts of 200 tokens, the paper's Mistral watermark settings (Table 2: layer 20 up_proj, sigma^2=1e-5). Values under experiments.*.results are the paper's reported numbers (read from Figure 2a/7/1a, Table 3 and Figure 4); the gym does not require matching them. Everything the paper reports that this gym does not score is kept verbatim under _paper_reported_unscored.

watermark_detection_mistral_removed_metr.note: Metrics of the earlier gym that are no longer scored (wall-clock timing is not allowed as a metric; CE delta duplicates the CE ratio; FPRs are now enforced by the evaluator's validity gate).

watermark_detection_llama.description: GaussMark detection on Llama3.1-8B (Figure 2a). Uses layer 28, up_proj, sigma^2=3e-4. Paper reports ~95% at FPR=0.05 and ~82% at FPR=0.01 for 200 tokens.

watermark_detection_phi.description: GaussMark detection on Phi3.5-Mini (Figure 2a). More challenging model (lower entropy sequences). Uses layer 20, down_proj, sigma^2=1e-3. Paper reports ~65% at FPR=0.05 and ~40% at FPR=0.01 for 200 tokens.

model_quality_superglue.description: Model quality on SuperGLUE benchmark — watermarked vs unwatermarked (Table 1). GaussMark should have no significant impact on model quality.

robustness_figure4_mistral_at_20pct.note: Paper Figure 4 (a)-(c), Mistral-7B, TPR at p<0.05 after editing 20% of the generated tokens, read from the plots. The figure's clean TPR is ~0.94, i.e. longer texts than the 200 tokens scored here, so these values are not on this gym's scale.

watermark_detection_mistral.description: Detection of marked Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 text (200 new tokens, temperature 1, top-p 0.9) on 400 held-out C4 prompts under 8 secret keys, at the paper's nominal p-value thresholds, without degrading the model: C4 cross-entropy of the marked model relative to the original on held-out human text (paper Table 3). Gates (run scored as failed, worst value everywhere): impossible/missing p-values, model tampering, C4 cross-entropy ratio > 1.015, or a false-positive count significantly above the nominal level (one-sided binomial p < 1e-3) on unwatermarked-model text, human text, or marked text tested with the wrong key.

detection_rate_fpr_0.05.description: Fraction of marked texts with p < 0.05 (paper: 'fraction detected at p = 0.05').

detection_rate_fpr_0.01.description: Fraction of marked texts with p < 0.01 (paper Figure 7a).

auc.description: ROC AUC of marked vs pooled null texts, lower p = marked (paper Figure 7b).

median_p_value.description: Median p-value of marked texts (paper Figure 1a).

c4_cross_entropy_ratio.description: Per-token cross-entropy of the marked model / original model on held-out human C4 documents, averaged over keys (paper Table 3). Hard budget 1.015.

false_positive_rate_0.05.description: Validity diagnostic, not ranked: fraction of pooled null texts with p < 0.05. An exact test sits at 0.05; lower is not better. Enforced by the binomial gate.

false_positive_rate_0.01.description: Validity diagnostic, not ranked: fraction of pooled null texts with p < 0.01. Enforced by the binomial gate.

watermark_robustness_mistral.description: Detection after the paper's token-level corruptions (Sec. 4.3): the evaluator edits 20% of the tokens of every marked and every unwatermarked text with random substitutions, deletions or insertions (one attack per text, balanced). Same model, prompts, keys and gates as watermark_detection_mistral. Added as the headroom experiment: the paper's method loses much of its power here.

detection_rate_fpr_0.05.description: Fraction of corrupted marked texts with p < 0.05 (paper Figure 4).

auc.description: ROC AUC of corrupted marked vs corrupted unwatermarked texts (paper Figure 17).

median_p_value.description: Median p-value of corrupted marked texts (paper Figure 16).

false_positive_rate_0.05.description: Validity diagnostic, not ranked: fraction of corrupted unwatermarked texts with p < 0.05.
